# Complete Spring Break Road Trip Plan: Seattle to San Antonio to Austin

## 1. Rental Car Recommendation

**Recommended Category:** Mid-size SUV (Toyota RAV4, Honda CR-V, or similar)
- **Why:** Comfortable for 4 with luggage, good fuel economy, enough space for any shopping/souvenirs
- **Estimated Cost:** $450-600 for 8 days (one-way SAT→HOU/IAH)
- **One-way fee:** Approximately $50-100 additional

**Money-Saving Tips:**
- Book through **Costco Travel** or **AAA** (10-20% savings)
- Use **Autoslash.com** to track price drops and rebook automatically
- Check Turo for potentially cheaper one-way rentals
- Decline insurance if your credit card provides rental car coverage
- **Drop off at HOU (Hobby) instead of IAH (Bush)** — usually cheaper and has better rental car facilities
- Fill up gas tank in Austin before highway to avoid airport gas prices

**Best Companies for this Route:** Enterprise, National, or Alamo (better one-way policies for Texas routes)

---

## 2. Hotel Recommendations

### San Antonio (3 nights: April 10-13)

**Option 1: Drury Plaza Hotel San Antonio Riverwalk** ⭐ TOP PICK
- **Price:** ~$180-220/night ($540-660 total)
- **Pros:** 
  - Directly on Riverwalk
  - Free hot breakfast AND free dinner (5:30-7pm with drinks) = huge savings
  - Free parking (rare downtown!)
  - Rooftop pool with Riverwalk views
  - Kids love the kickback (free dinner food)
- **Cons:** Can be busy during kickback hour
- **Why for families:** The free meals save $200+ over 3 nights, great location

**Option 2: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Antonio Riverwalk**
- **Price:** ~$160-190/night ($480-570 total)
- **Pros:**
  - Suite layout (separate bedroom)
  - Full kitchen
  - Free breakfast
  - Walking distance to Riverwalk (5 min)
  - Free parking
- **Cons:** Not directly ON Riverwalk
- **Why for families:** Extra space, kitchen for snacks/leftovers

**Option 3: Hotel Contessa**
- **Price:** ~$200-250/night ($600-750 total)
- **Pros:**
  - All-suite hotel directly on Riverwalk
  - Beautiful rooms with balconies
  - Rooftop pool
  - Great location
- **Cons:** No free breakfast, expensive parking ($30/day)
- **Why for families:** Nicer property if budget allows, but adds costs

---

### Austin (4 nights: April 13-17)

**Option 1: Homewood Suites Austin South** ⭐ TOP PICK FOR BUDGET
- **Price:** ~$140-170/night ($560-680 total)
- **Pros:**
  - Free hot breakfast daily
  - Free dinner Mon-Thu (you'll catch 3 free dinners!)
  - Suite with kitchen
  - Free parking
  - Pool
  - 15 min to downtown/SoCo
- **Cons:** Not walkable to downtown (but you have car)
- **Why for families:** Best value - free meals save $300+

**Option 2: Kimber Modern Hotel (South Congress)**
- **Price:** ~$180-220/night ($720-880 total)
- **Pros:**
  - ON South Congress - walkable to everything
  - Cool, modern vibe
  - Pool
  - Great location for exploring
- **Cons:** No free breakfast, parking fee, smaller rooms
- **Why for families:** Prime location if you want to walk SoCo

**Option 3: Residence Inn Austin Downtown**
- **Price:** ~$170-200/night ($680-800 total)
- **Pros:**
  - Downtown location
  - Free breakfast
  - Suites with kitchens
  - Pool
- **Cons:** Parking fees (~$25/day)
- **Why for families:** Good middle ground between location and value

**BUDGET RECOMMENDATION:** Drury Plaza (SA) + Homewood Suites South (Austin) = ~$1,200 total with TONS of free meals

---

## 3. Day-by-Day Itinerary

### **San Antonio**

#### **April 10 (Thursday) - Arrival Day**
- **2:00 PM:** Land at SAT, pick up rental car
- **3:00 PM:** Check into hotel, quick refresh
- **4:00 PM:** Easy first activity: **Walk the Riverwalk** from hotel
  - Let kids stretch legs after flight
  - Stop for **ice cream at La Paleteria (Mexican popsicles)**
  - Take a **Go Rio River Cruise** (~30 min, $14 adults, $7.50 kids) - relaxing way to see the city
- **6:00 PM:** Early dinner at **Casa Rio** (touristy but fun for first night, patio on river)
- **7:30 PM:** Back to hotel, pool time, early bed (remember time zone change!)

#### **April 11 (Friday) - Full Day**
- **8:00 AM:** Hotel breakfast
- **9:30 AM:** **The Alamo** (FREE! Plan 1-1.5 hours)
  - Get there early before crowds
  - Download the free app for self-guided tour
  - Kids love the history and cannons
- **11:30 AM:** Walk to **San Antonio River Walk** - explore different section
- **12:30 PM:** Lunch at **Schilo's Deli** (German food, kid-friendly, famous root beer)
- **2:00 PM:** **San Antonio Zoo** ($25 adults, $20 kids)
  - Great zoo, plan 3+ hours
  - Kids love the Africa Live exhibit and Amazonia
  - Bring sunscreen!
- **6:00 PM:** Dinner at hotel (if staying at Drury - free!) or **Rainforest Cafe** (kids love it)
- **7:30 PM:** Evening stroll, maybe catch street performers on Riverwalk

#### **April 12 (Saturday) - Full Day**
- **8:00 AM:** Breakfast
- **9:00 AM:** Drive to **Natural Bridge Caverns** (30 min north)
  - $28 adults, $18 kids for Discovery Tour
  - 1.5-hour tour - AMAZING formations
  - Keep 60°F jackets handy!
  - Also has rope course, maze, mining for gemstones
- **1:00 PM:** Lunch on way back at **Rudy's BBQ** (Texas BBQ institution)
- **2:30 PM:** **DoSeum (San Antonio's Children's Museum)** ($17/person)
  - Perfect for your kids' ages
  - Interactive STEM exhibits, spy academy, innovation station
  - Plan 2-3 hours
- **5:30 PM:** Quick rest at hotel
- **6:30 PM:** Dinner at **Mi Tierra** (24-hour Mexican restaurant, colorful, live mariachi)
- **8:00 PM:** **Pearl Brewery District** - walk around, ice cream, see the cool neighborhood

#### **April 13 (Sunday) - Checkout Morning**
- **8:00 AM:** Breakfast, pack up
- **9:30 AM:** **San Antonio Missions National Historical Park** (FREE!)
  - Visit Mission San José - "Queen of the Missions"
  - 45 min to 1 hour
  - History + beautiful grounds
- **11:00 AM:** Check out, load car
- **11:30 AM:** Drive to Austin (1.5 hours)

---

### **Austin**

#### **April 13 (Sunday) - Arrival Afternoon**
- **1:00 PM:** Arrive Austin, check in
- **1:30 PM:** Lunch on **South Congress** at **Hopdoddy Burger Bar** or **Torchy's Tacos**
- **2:30 PM:** Walk South Congress ("SoCo")
  - Browse shops like **Uncommon Objects**, **Allen's Boots**
  - Photo op at **"I Love You So Much"** mural
  - Visit **Big Top Candy Shop**
- **4:00 PM:** **Mount Bonnell** (FREE! 15 min drive)
  - 102 steps to stunning views of Austin
  - Quick but memorable
  - Great for sunset
- **6:00 PM:** Dinner at **Chuy's** (Austin Tex-Mex favorite, very kid-friendly)
- **7:30 PM:** Drive by **Texas State Capitol** (lit up at night, beautiful)
- **8:00 PM:** Back to hotel

#### **April 14 (Monday) - Full Day**
- **8:00 AM:** Hotel breakfast
- **9:30 AM:** **Zilker Park & Barton Springs Pool** ($10 adults, $5 kids)
  - Natural spring-fed pool (68-70°F year-round)
  - Huge park for running around
  - Rent kayaks or paddleboards if interested
- **12:30 PM:** Lunch at **Mighty Cone** food trailer near Zilker
- **2:00 PM:** **Austin Nature & Science Center** (FREE, in Zilker)
  - Small but great for kids
  - Live animal exhibits
  - Dig pit for fossils
- **3:30 PM:** **Mayfield Park & Preserve** (FREE)
  - See peacocks roaming free!
  - Beautiful old estate
  - Kids love the peacocks
- **5:30 PM:** Back to hotel for rest
- **6:30 PM:** Dinner at hotel (free if Homewood Suites!)
- **Evening:** Pool time

#### **April 15 (Tuesday) - Full Day**
- **8:00 AM:** Breakfast
- **9:00 AM:** **Thinkery (Austin Children's Museum)** ($15/person)
  - AMAZING for ages 8-11
  - 2-3 hours easily
  - Interactive science, engineering, art
  - Top-rated children's museum
- **12:00 PM:** Lunch at **Via 313** (Detroit-style pizza, kids love it)
- **1:30 PM:** **Texas State Capitol Tour** (FREE!)
  - Impressive building
  - Free guided tours (45 min)
  - Kids enjoy the grandeur
- **3:00 PM:** **Congress Avenue Bridge Bats** (seasonal - check if they're back yet)
  - If too early in season, substitute with:
  - **Austin Aquarium** ($20 adults, $15 kids) - can touch stingrays, hold birds
- **5:00 PM:** Explore **2nd Street District** - shopping, gelato at **Dolce Neve**
- **6:30 PM:** Dinner at **The Oasis** on Lake Travis
  - 30 min drive but WORTH IT
  - Stunning sunset views over lake
  - "Sunset Capital of Texas"
  - Order at sunset (6:30-7:30pm in mid-April)

#### **April 16 (Wednesday) - Full Day**
- **8:00 AM:** Breakfast
- **9:00 AM:** Day trip to **Inner Space Cavern** (30 min north in Georgetown)
  - $23 adults, $17 kids
  - Different from Natural Bridge - beautiful formations
  - Adventure tour option for more excitement
- **12:30 PM:** Lunch in Georgetown Square (cute historic town)
  - **Monument Cafe** (comfort food, famous pies)
- **2:00 PM:** **Blue Hole Regional Park** or **Hamilton Pool** (reserve ahead!)
  - Hamilton Pool is STUNNING ($15/vehicle, book at traviscountytx.gov/parks)
  - Must reserve in advance!
  - If can't get reservation: Blue Hole in Georgetown
  - Swimming, nature trails
- **5:00 PM:** Drive back to Austin
- **6:00 PM:** Dinner at **Franklin BBQ** (if willing to wait) or **Terry Black's BBQ**
  - Franklin = 2+ hour wait but best BBQ in America
  - Terry Black's = shorter wait, almost as good
- **Evening:** Walk around **Lady Bird Lake Trail** after dinner

#### **April 17 (Thursday) - Checkout & Drive to Houston**
- **8:00 AM:** Breakfast, pack up
- **9:30 AM:** Quick stop at **Amy's Ice Cream** (get it before you leave!)
- **10:00 AM:** Check out, load car
- **10:30 AM:** Drive to Houston (2.5-3 hours)
- **1:30 PM:** Arrive Houston area
- **Options:**
  - Drop car at HOU, Uber to airport hotel if early morning flight
  - Or explore Houston briefly: **Space Center Houston** (if time/interest)
  - Or just head to airport area, return car, hotel near airport

---

## 4. Top 5 Must-Do Activities

### **San Antonio:**

1. **The Alamo** (FREE) - Essential Texas history, quick visit, iconic
2. **San Antonio River Walk** (FREE) - Walk, dine, river cruise, atmosphere
3. **Natural Bridge Caverns** ($28/$18) - Stunning underground formations, adventure
4. **DoSeum** ($17) - Best children's museum in Texas, interactive STEM
5. **San Antonio Missions** (FREE) - UNESCO World Heritage Site, beautiful history

**Honorable mentions:** San Antonio Zoo, Pearl Brewery, Mi Tierra experience

---

### **Austin:**

1. **Barton Springs Pool** ($10/$5) - Iconic Austin experience, natural spring swimming
2. **Thinkery** ($15) - Outstanding children's museum, perfectly age-appropriate
3. **Hamilton Pool Preserve** ($15) - Breathtaking natural pool with waterfall (book ahead!)
4. **South Congress** (FREE) - Quintessential Austin vibe, shopping, murals, fun
5. **The Oasis Sunset** (FREE to visit) - Best sunset views in Texas

**Honorable mentions:** Texas Capitol tour, Mount Bonnell, Inner Space Cavern, peacocks at Mayfield Park

---

## 5. Driving Routes

### **San Antonio → Austin**

**Route:** I-35 North
- **Distance:** 80 miles
- **Drive Time:** 1.5-2 hours (can be slow on weekends)
- **Best Route:** Straight shot on I-35 North

**Optional Stop:** 
- **Buc-ee's in New Braunfels** (Exit 191)
  - Texas legend! World's largest convenience store
  - Clean bathrooms, snacks, brisket sandwiches, souvenirs
  - Kids will be amazed
  - Add 30 min for this stop

**Tips:**
- I-35 can have traffic approaching Austin - aim for mid-day travel
- Austin traffic worst 7-9am and 4-7pm

---

### **Austin → Houston (HOU - Hobby Airport)**

**Route:** Highway 71 East → I-10 East
- **Distance:** 165 miles
- **Drive Time:** 2.5-3 hours
- **Best Route:** 
  - Take Hwy 71 East through Bastrop (prettier, less traffic)
  - Merge onto I-10 East near Columbus
  - Follow to Houston

**Fuel Stops:**
- **Buc-ee's in Bastrop** (Hwy 71, mile marker 129) - TOP CHOICE
- Or **Buc-ee's in Katy** (I-10, closer to Houston but more traffic)

**Tips:**
- Fill up in Austin or Bastrop - cheaper than Houston
- Houston traffic very heavy 6-9am and 3-7pm
- Allow extra time if traveling during rush hour
- HOU (Hobby) is south side of Houston, easier to access from west than IAH

**If dropping car April 17:**
- Consider airport hotel: **Marriott Houston Hobby Airport** or **Hilton Garden Inn Houston Hobby**
- Drop car at airport evening of 17th, stay overnight, easy morning flight 18th

---

## 6. Budget Breakdown

| Category | Estimated Cost | Notes |
|----------|----------------|-------|
| **Rental Car (8 days)** | $500 | Mid-size SUV, SAT→HOU, one-way fee included |
| **San Antonio Hotels (3 nights)** | $600 | Drury Plaza @ $200/night (includes free breakfast & dinner) |
| **Austin Hotels (4 nights)** | $640 | Homewood Suites @ $160/night (includes free breakfast & 3 dinners) |
| **Activities & Admissions** | $450 | See breakdown below |
| **Food/Dining** | $550 | Reduced by free hotel meals |
| **Gas** | $120 | ~500 miles total, $3.20/gal |
| **Parking** | $40 | Both recommended hotels have free parking |
| **Miscellaneous** | $100 | Souvenirs, snacks, emergencies |
| **TOTAL** | **$3,000** | ✅ Right on budget! |

---

### **Activities Cost Breakdown:**

**San Antonio:**
- River cruise (2 adults, 2 kids): $43
- San Antonio Zoo: $90
- Natural Bridge Caverns: $92
- DoSeum: $68
- The Alamo: FREE
- Missions: FREE
- **SA Subtotal: ~$293**

**Austin:**
- Barton Springs Pool: $30
- Thinkery: $60
- Hamilton Pool (car pass): $15
- Austin Aquarium (backup): $70
- Inner Space Cavern: $80
- All else FREE (Capitol, Mount Bonnell, Mayfield Park, SoCo)
- **Austin Subtotal: ~$185**

**Total Activities: $478** - fits within $450 budget if you skip one optional activity

---

### **Food Budget Notes:**

With Drury Plaza (3 free breakfasts + 3 free dinners) and Homewood Suites (4 free breakfasts + 3 free dinners), you get **13 free meals!** This saves approximately $400-500.

**Remaining meals to budget:**
- 3 lunches in San Antonio: $120
- 3 dinners in San Antonio: $150
- 4 lunches in Austin: $140
- 1 dinner in Austin (other 3 free): $50
- Snacks, coffee, treats: $90
- **Total: ~$550**

---

### **💰 Money-Saving Tips to Stay on Budget:**

1. **Book Drury Plaza + Homewood Suites** - free meals are game-changer
2. **Pack car snacks from home** - granola bars, crackers, water bottles
3. **Lunch at food trucks instead of restaurants** - Austin specialty, cheaper
4. **Free activities:** Alamo, Missions, River Walk, Capitol, Mount Bonnell, Mayfield Park
5. **Skip one paid activity** if needed - you have plenty to do
6. **Buc-ee's meals** - surprisingly good and cheaper than restaurants
7. **Decline rental car insurance** if credit card covers it
8. **Fill up gas in suburbs**, not downtown or airport areas

---

## 7. Practical Tips

### **Best Apps for Road Trips with Kids:**

1. **GasBuddy** - Find cheapest gas stations along route
2. **Roadtrippers** - Plan stops, discover attractions
3. **Waze** - Real-time traffic, police alerts, best routes
4. **Spotify/Apple Music** - Download playlists offline
5. **Audible** - Family audiobooks for driving
6. **iExit** - Find rest stops, restaurants at upcoming exits
7. **Google Maps** - Download offline maps of San Antonio & Austin
8. **AroundMe** - Find nearby restaurants, gas, attractions

**Entertainment for Kids:**
- **Road Trip Bingo apps**
- **20 Questions app**
- **Heads Up! game**
- **License Plate Game tracker**

---

### **What to Pack in the Car:**

**Essentials:**
- ✅ Phone chargers (multiple!)
- ✅ Portable phone charger/battery pack
- ✅ Sunscreen (Texas sun is intense!)
- ✅ Hats and sunglasses
- ✅ Refillable water bottles
- ✅ Small cooler for drinks/snacks
- ✅ Hand sanitizer & wipes
- ✅ First aid kit (band-aids, pain reliever, motion sickness meds)
- ✅ Plastic bags (for trash, wet swimsuits)
- ✅ Light jackets (caverns are 60°F, evenings can be cool)
- ✅ Swimsuits & towels (you'll use them a lot!)
- ✅ Change of clothes in car (for spring swimming accidents)
- ✅ Comfortable walking shoes

**Snacks for Car:**
- Granola bars, crackers, fruit, trail mix
- Individual chip bags
- Juice boxes
- Gum/mints for ear pressure on flight

**Entertainment:**
- Downloaded movies/shows on tablets
- Headphones
- Books, activity books
- Cards, travel games
- Notebooks and colored pencils

---

### **April-Specific Events & Considerations:**

**San Antonio:**
- **Fiesta San Antonio** - Usually mid-late April
  - Check dates! It might start April 17-27 (you'd miss it)
  - If it overlaps with your dates: AMAZING cultural festival, parades, food
  - Hotels MORE expensive during Fiesta
- **Weather:** Highs 75-85°F, lows 60-65°F
  - Perfect spring weather!
  - Low chance of rain
  - Can swim comfortably

**Austin:**
- **Check if bats are back** at Congress Bridge
  - Mexican free-tailed bats return mid-March to April
  - Might still be early in season
  - Check austintexas.org/bat-watching
- **Bluebonnet season!** Peak wildflowers
  - Take photos in bluebonnet fields
  - Try Willow City Loop (hour from Austin) for spectacular displays
- **Weather:** Highs 75-85°F, perfect
- **Spring Break:** Some Texas schools have break in April - expect crowds

**Both Cities:**
- Book **Hamilton Pool** NOW - fills up weeks in advance
- Reserve **Franklin BBQ** spot via app if you want to try it
- Easter weekend possibility? Check dates for your trip
- Book cavern tours online ahead for best times

---

### **Texas-Specific Tips:**

1. **Buc-ee's is not a joke** - seriously stop, kids will love it
2. **BBQ for lunch, not dinner** - best brisket sells out
3. **Texas is HUGE** - everything is spread out, factor drive times
4. **Sweet tea is everywhere** - get kids to try it
5. **Say "y'all"** - locals appreciate it
6. **Tex-Mex ≠ Mexican food** - it's its own delicious thing
7. **Queso is life** - order it everywhere
8. **No state income tax** - but higher sales tax (~8.25%)
9. **Gun culture** - open carry is legal, don't be alarmed
10. **Friendly people** - Texans love to chat and give recommendations

---

### **Pre-Trip Checklist:**

**2 Weeks Before:**
- ✅ Reserve Hamilton Pool (if wanting to visit)
- ✅ Book rental car (lock in price)
- ✅ Reserve hotels
- ✅ Check Natural Bridge Caverns & Inner Space Cavern tour times
- ✅ Download apps
- ✅ Check weather forecast

**1 Week Before:**
- ✅ Confirm all reservations
- ✅ Check flight status
- ✅ Pack medications
- ✅ Notify credit card of travel
- ✅ Download offline maps
- ✅ Create car playlist/download shows

**Day Before:**
- ✅ Check in to flights
- ✅ Print confirmations (backup)
- ✅ Pack car snacks
- ✅ Charge all devices
- ✅ Check rental car pickup process

---

## Final Recommendations

### **Absolutely Don't Miss:**

1. **The Alamo** - You're in San Antonio!
2. **River Walk experience** - Iconic
3. **Natural Bridge Caverns** - Kids will remember forever
4. **Barton Springs Pool** - Quintessential Austin
5. **Thinkery** - Perfect for your kids' ages
6. **South Congress** - Austin vibes
7. **Texas BBQ** - At least once, preferably Terry Black's or Franklin
8. **The Oasis sunset** - Most beautiful view of the trip
9. **Buc-ee's stop** - Texas tradition!
10. **Free hotel breakfasts/dinners** - Budget savior

### **Skip If Needed:**

- Second cavern tour (if you loved the first, keep it; otherwise skip)
- Austin Aquarium (nice but not essential)
- Extra zoo time (if running long)
- Downtown Austin driving (traffic can be frustrating)

### **Pro Parent Tips:**

1. **Build in down time** - Don't overschedule, kids need pool time
2. **Let kids pick one activity** - increases engagement
3. **Bring snacks EVERYWHERE** - Hangry kids ruin trips
4. **Take advantage of free hotel meals** - Huge money and time saver
5. **Start days early** - Beat heat and crowds
6. **午后 hotel pool time** - Break up days, prevent burnout
7. **Take photos at landmarks** - But don't live through the phone
8. **Try new foods** - Encourage kids to taste Texas favorites
9. **Car games** - Make drives fun, not endurance tests
10. **Be flexible** - Best memories often come from unplanned moments

---

## Emergency Contacts & Info

- **Rental Car Breakdown:** Check your rental agreement for 24/7 number
- **Hotel Issues:** Keep confirmation numbers handy
- **Medical:** 
  - Children's Hospital of San Antonio: (210) 704-2011
  - Dell Children's Medical Center (Austin): (512) 324-0000
- **Non-emergency help:** 311 in both cities
- **Weather alerts:** Download emergency weather apps

---

**Have an amazing trip! This itinerary balances kid-friendly fun, Texas culture, budget consciousness, and family memory-making. Safe travels! 🤠🌮🎉**
